node.title: Bloqueo de mapas actual y objetivo
node.summary: Both the current-state representation and a legitimate route to the target may be inadequate.

relations: A reversible provisional declaration can help discover a route between current and target states, while keeping exploration separate from an irreversible ownership or retirement decision.
Double-map deadlock permanece como constructo propuesto; no se demuestra incomputabilidad formal por la falta de un mapa.
The minimum-information lens turns an attractive target into an actionable transition question: what must be known, decided and authorized for the next move to become possible?
La ficha propuesta no asegura una solución Pareto-mejor ni sustituye negociación, financiación o requisitos regulatorios.
